items.title: A presheaf with values in C is a sheaf exactly when its underlying presheaf of sets is
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file sheaves.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: 20 行、C 值层的等价刻画：正向用 F 与极限交换把 C 层条件搬成集合层条件；反向对 C-等化子 E 的典范映射在 F 上是同构（集合层条件），F 反射同构得原映射同构。承重三步（等化子交换、典范映射、反射）都在 span 内；1 处引用（定义）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-sheaves-structure (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 993-1007

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: forward: F commutes with equalizers, so F(F(U)) is the equalizer of sets, i.e. the sheaf condition; converse: the canonical map F(U) -> E to the C-equalizer becomes an isomorphism on F by the set-equalizer computation, hence is an isomorphism since F reflects isomorphisms (source lines 1009-1028)
